title: KoreLumina — Master OS - KoreLumina Knowledge Extraction

messages.content:
The audit is clean: there are no remaining consumers of any capsuleFlow* token outside flagshipAppearance.ts, and the working tree is clean. That makes this a safe dead-code deletion milestone.
Remove only the now-unused Flow token block:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina || exit 1
set -e

test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "inspect/runtime-certified-main"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "2d41a4d5cc399096f7ae4ce47f76441e838ab538"

FILE="apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/presentation/flagshipAppearance.ts"

python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/presentation/"
    "flagshipAppearance.ts"
)

text = path.read_text()

start = text.find("  capsuleFlowShell: [")
end = text.find("  divider:", start)

if start == -1:
    raise SystemExit("capsuleFlow block start not found")

if end == -1:
    raise SystemExit("capsuleFlow block end marker not found")

block = text[start:end]

required = [
    "capsuleFlowShell",
    "capsuleFlowHeader",
    "capsuleFlowMetric",
    "capsuleFlowCanvas",
    "capsuleFlowZone",
    "capsuleFlowZoneTone",
    "capsuleFlowOccupancyBadge",
    "capsuleFlowStation",
    "capsuleFlowStationCount",
    "capsuleFlowBranch",
    "capsuleFlowBranchTone",
    "capsuleFlowEmptyStation",
]

missing = [token for token in required if token not in block]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected tokens missing from deletion block: {missing}")

text = text[:start] + text[end:]
path.write_text(text)
PY

printf '%s\n' "===== VERIFY NO capsuleFlow TOKENS REMAIN ====="
if grep -n 'capsuleFlow' "$FILE"; then
  echo "ERROR: capsuleFlow definitions remain"
  exit 1
fi

printf '%s\n' "===== VERIFY NO capsuleFlow CONSUMERS EXIST ====="
if grep -Rni \
  'flagshipAppearance\.capsuleFlow' \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge
then
  echo "ERROR: capsuleFlow consumer remains"
  exit 1
fi

git diff --check
npm run build

printf '%s\n' "===== DEAD FLOW TOKEN CLEANUP ====="
git diff -- "$FILE"

printf '%s\n' "===== EXECUTIVE / FLAGSHIP IMMUTABILITY ====="
git diff --exit-code -- \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/design-system/lumina/executive/ribbon/LuminaExecutiveRibbon.tsx \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/lumina/workspace/primitives/LuminaFlagshipPanel.tsx \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/lumina/workspace/primitives/LuminaFlagshipCard.tsx \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/lumina/workspace/primitives/LuminaFlagshipSurface.tsx

printf '%s\n' "===== STATUS ====="
git status --short
This is cleanup only; there should be no visual change. If build and UI remain green, this closes the Flow Engine legacy appearance-token ownership.

Green accepted for the dead Flow-token cleanup.
The local validation is clean: no capsuleFlow* definitions remain, no consumers remain, npm run build passed, git diff --check passed, and only flagshipAppearance.ts is modified.
Commit and push this approved cleanup:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina || exit 1
set -e

git add \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/presentation/flagshipAppearance.ts

git commit -m "refactor(knowledge): remove obsolete flow appearance tokens"

git push

git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short

Architectural state

Executive material → Lumina primitives → Lumina compositions → Knowledge workspace consumers

After that, the next logical milestone is whichever remaining workspace has the highest residual local visual ownership. Do not begin backend wiring yet.
